narrative.headline: Find compatible HELLO CYCLING pickup and return stations with timestamped counts and published pricing.
narrative.value_prop: Search Japanese station names and addresses, rank explicit-coordinate pickup/return choices, and compare compatible trip endpoints. Source timestamps, missing counts, and model-dependent pricing constraints remain attached to every result.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account, API key or location permission is required. Anonymous provider-published GBFS and first-party price pages are read through HTTP. Reserve rides only in the official app.

quickstart.comment: Verify local setup without making a ride request.
Inspect model and municipal rate exceptions.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for HELLO CYCLING station discovery, observed bike/return-space counts and compatible pickup/dropoff comparison in Japan. Require explicit latitude/longitude for nearby searches. Use source app links to confirm the actual bike, rate and return eligibility.
anti_triggers: Reservations, rides, payments or account changes
Location-permission access or geocoding without explicit coordinates
Guaranteed availability, model eligibility or a final ride quote
